title: A rate-limited turn offers Resend; a usage-limited turn asks for another model or account

source.name: a rate limit asks to try again shortly and offers Resend

steps.message: API Error: Request rejected (429) · This request would exceed your account's rate limit. Please try again later.
You've reached your Codex usage limit. It will reset in about 5 hours.

invariant: The 429 turn reads 'Rate limited · Try again shortly.' with a Resend button; the exhausted window reads 'Usage limit reached' with no button.
